text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still in Love's second Queen Elizabeth II Cup begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I have come to pick you up.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Today...
you're wearing sunglasses, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For the past few days, the redness in my irises hasn't faded. I could hide it with colored contacts... but I chose sunglasses to shield against the sunlight as well.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...It suits you, very well.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
By the way, have you eaten yet?
If you'd like, would you care to join me for breakfast...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“That's a lie. Truth is, I can't even remember
the last time I had a proper meal.”
choice_data_list: First, we have an interview. Let's go.
First, we have an interview. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Shall we decline after all?
Or perhaps, I could go alone.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You also seem to be in pain, so...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: However...
choice_data_list: Let me go. ...Because you are going down in history.
Let me go... You're meant to make history, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not just as a Triple Tiara Umamusume,
but today, surpassing Admire Groove...
carving out a new legacy. Her strides will never cease.
choice_data_list: (Still, I... probably won't be able to see it through to the end.)
(Still, I... probably won't be able to see it through to the end.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then I'll do everything in my power... As the Trainer who knows the 'now' of a girl destined for even greater heights—I want to share her story.
choice_data_list: I have to let everyone know how amazing you are...
I have to let everyone know just how wonderful you are...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
...It's all right, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I will win today.
I will never betray your expectations...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "...Now then, shall we go? Take my hand, if you please."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more...
—Just a little longer, so please.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove really awakened at last year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup, didn't she?
I remember how incredible it was...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still... Still in Love's intensity lately...
Isn't it getting a bit too crazy?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Yeah... She's a magnificent Triple Tiara Umamusume, just like Mejiro Ramonu, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...It's just... so alien.
It's kind of hard to cheer for him, or rather—

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!?
M-Mejiro Ramonu...!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "Will that beast fall from grace... or fall into a trap?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: This will be a spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Groove-san...
...I look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I am terribly sorry... for showing you such a pathetic run previously.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine today.
—Because I've come back... to your side.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The way you all are right now
is wrong.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I was jealous.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "Caring for each other so deeply... I was jealous of you two."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"If I didn't look away, I couldn't keep myself together.
...Because it was something I never had."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: “However, that's not right. It's intolerable……”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That's... that's not the love I dreamed of.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The way you all are right now has to be wrong.
If I accept it—my future will be warped too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I'll teach you.
That pure conviction translates to true strength."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: With all the love I've been given.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...How nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? To me...
you were the one who shone so brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"You were shining... and even now, you're so loved...
Everything you have is what I lacked..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: However...—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I don't need it.
I have nothing left to ask for.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"You cannot deny who we are.
Because—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: It hurts... so much.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"As long as this pain burns—
I won't let anyone get in my way...!!"
